norm_title expands Quant and Assoc with.why: the spec only says abbreviations are expanded; it never says the rest of the title is lower-cased (the first set's 'Store Manager' case keeps case). Case does not matter for similarity

norm_title expands Sr dot and Eng after.why: the spec only says abbreviations are expanded; it never says the rest of the title is lower-cased (the first set's 'Store Manager' case keeps case). Case does not matter for similarity

career_links: ATS posting links come fir.why: fixed 2026-11-03 f: links into a recognised ATS are now selected even when their text says neither careers nor jobs

Cases for the new form: ats_search_d_cases.json
